rules.statement: The obligation to pass transfer lies with the vendor, and the purchaser is entitled to specific performance of the agreement if the vendor fails to tender the conveyance within the stipulated period.
rules.supporting_quote: "By Roman Dutch Law the obligation is upon the Vendor to pass transfer and for this purpose he may appoint his own conveyancer although the Purchaser may by the terms of the contract be compelled to pay the costs of the transfer."
